Warriors 126Magic 119

Curry's 41 wins it in overtime

Final · OT · Sat, Nov 7 · Golden State

Golden State beat Orlando 126–119 in overtime, a 7-point home win. The Warriors move to 7–3; the Magic fall to 2–7.

1 of 7 · The verdict

Won it shooting and off the bench.

Assists 32–29; bench points 42–31. Orlando grabbed 24 offensive rebounds.

2 of 7 · How it went

A 16-point lead, gone.

Up as many as 16, the Warriors let it slip: up 12 after one, up 16 at the half, down 1 after three, tied after four, won overtime 16–9.

3 of 7 · The moment

The and-one.

Curry's floater through contact with 1:38 left in overtime, a three-point play that turned a 118–117 deficit into a 120–118 lead for good.
